provenance: Runs on CPU with the checkpoint's tokenizer.json (through `tokenizers`) and chat template (through transformers); no weights. The method is Qwen3.8's (fixtures/qwen38/capture/prompts.py): the haystack and the three needles of MiMo's functional needle prompt (`$CHOPINFER_MIMO_FIXTURES/functional/context-524288.json`), decoded with MiMo's tokenizer, rebuilt in GLM's chat format at GLM token lengths, with the needles in front of the paragraphs nearest 10%, 50% and 90% of the haystack. Unlike Qwen's, the prompt keeps GLM's generation prompt (`<|assistant|><think>`, the template has no thinking-off form) with reasoning effort Low, and each row leaves 1,024 tokens to answer, so a short reasoning fits before the answer.
